title: It's kind of ugly
text: It's kind of ugly. I purchased this to fill with led lights since I don't have room for a tree. Also bought some miniature ornaments - went without a Christmas tree for the last 3 yrs and it was just getting depressing.  I do think I'll have fun arranging light and ornaments.  It is a little ugly but it goes with all my other strange stuff.

product_metadata.title: Elements 5181406 Embossed Decorative Metal Vase, 17-Inch, Silver
features: INTRIGUING FINISH: This Silver vase features an elegant patchwork embossment with filagree detail

description: Timeless style meets a modern touch with this Elements Silver embossed decorative vase. Beautifully crafted of metal, this vase features a patchwork embossment with filagree detail. This vase looks great styled alone and when displaying your favorite dried or artificial flowers. For decorative use only; vase should not be used with water. Measures 4.5x4.5x17 inches.
